reason: I'd probably start the 14-day trial since there's no auto-charge, but I doubt a phone lying on the bed can really tell when I fell asleep, so a 'you fell asleep 6 minutes faster' result wouldn't convince me to pay. The free version with no ads and a timer already covers what I do with my earphones every night.
objection: The comparison is measured by the same app that wants my money, using phone movement, which isn't proof of anything. Also with earphones in I might roll over and not even touch the phone, so I don't trust the numbers.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the 14-day result match my smartwatch data with a clear, consistent difference, plus solid app-store reviews from people who say the measurement was accurate.
